title: Nook Works Read-only Batch Query Vertical Prototype
summary: 以 Daily Weather Batch 真實需求作第一個 requirement-driven vertical slice；沿用 S-SHELL-1 interaction language，以 representative mock fixtures 先驗證 Batch 執行紀錄的 query / list / detail / responsive interaction，再決定正式 Data Access Pattern。
flow: Business Requirement → Shell → Representative Mock → Query / List / Detail → Claire Functional Review → Technical Pattern
